programs.title: Dog Patrol: Season 12
programs.desc: A story about dogs who, together with their guardians, keep order in New Zealand.Viewers will see what cooperation between officers of various formations and animals looks like.

programs.title: The Story of Us With Morgan Freeman
programs.desc: Humans are prone to aggression.Morgan Freeman sets off on another journey to find out the reasons for the cyclical nature of war and peace.He seeks answers to the question whether conflicts are inevitable.He notes that sometimes innovations are a side effect.During his trip, the actor witnesses ritual fights during a Bolivian festival.He also learns about a program aimed at reconciliation after the genocide in Rwanda.Morgan Freeman will try to find out whether the fear of annihilation will make people more cautious about starting hostilities.

programs.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol 21
programs.desc: Weidman veterinarians treat, among others, a racehorse and a guinea fowl with a broken leg.Nicole takes in a seriously ill German Shepherd, and Lisa helps an injured cat.

programs.title: Europe From Above
programs.desc: Nat Geo People offers an intimate look at the lives of remarkable individuals and diverse cultures, sharing powerful human stories from across the globe.

programs.title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
programs.desc: After the hurricane, it turned out that the worst-case scenario had come true - almost all flood embankments were broken, which led to 80 percent of the city being flooded.Rescuers and ordinary citizens rushed to help those in need.Many people had to escape from home in search of shelter.As the water level rose, the incompetence of authorities at all levels, including the government, came to light.The late response of the services was later the subject of an investigation.

programs.title: Uncensored with Michael Ware
programs.desc: Michael Ware, former war correspondent, meets, among others,with rebels wanting to overthrow the Iranian government, he also flies to Papua New Guinea, where witch hunts are organized.
